title: CoordinateTransformations
description:
In almost all fields of science and engineering, it is essential to
identify and manipulate mathematical representations of physical,
real-world quantities. Robotics is no exception. Intelligent robots
build a "mental model" of themselves and the world as they perceive
their environments, and they modify those models when interpreting the
past and predicting the future. In an abstract sense, these models are
simply a collection of numbers and labels, with no explicit meaning to
the robot. It is the job of a robot engineer to correctly associate
numbers with meaning, and correspondingly, meanings with numbers. (If
this sounds like mumbo jumbo at the moment, some concrete examples will
be offered soon enough!)
